subject: Intro & Demo: Acme Analytics via Cloud Marketplace
messages:
From: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@acme-analytics.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-28T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: Acme Analytics - Marketplace inquiry re: Dedicated deployment + demo

Hi Ben,

We came across Redwood Inference on the cloud marketplace and are evaluating options for serving our models at scale. We're particularly interested in predictable throughput and VPC/private deployment options for sensitive client data.

Would love a quick intro + demo to see how Redwood's Dedicated and Private offerings compare with what we're considering. Initial context: 8-10 engineers, latency SLO ~150ms tail, need audit logs and SOC2 evidence.

Possible times next week: Tue (Mar 2) 11:00am PT or Wed (Mar 3) 9:00am PT.

I've attached a short requirements doc.

Thanks,
Jordan Ellis
Head of Platform
Acme Analytics
(Attachment: acme-requirements.pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-28T10:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Acme Analytics - Marketplace inquiry re: Dedicated deployment + demo

Hi Jordan - great to hear from you and thanks for the context. I'm Ben on the Sales team and I handle inbound marketplace leads.

Short answer: yes - we can absolutely demo Dedicated and Private options and walk through SOC 2/audit evidence. We also surface performance profiles for common open models so you can get rough unit-cost/latency estimates during the call.

Two quick options:
- I can run a 30-min intro + demo (product + AE) to cover architecture + perf profile.
- If you want a deeper deep-dive with a solutions engineer, we can book 60 mins and include Camila (she's cc'ed on a follow-up).

Times I have open: Tue Mar 2 at 11:00am PT, Tue Mar 2 at 2:00pm PT, Wed Mar 3 at 9:00am PT. If one of those works I'll send a calendar invite. Otherwise feel free to send a preferred slot or use my Calendly: https://calendly.com/ben-car/30min

Attaching a short demo deck so you can skim before the call.

Best,
Ben Carter
SDR, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
(Attachment: redwood-demo-deck.pdf)
